messages:
emma-finance: Heads up — CloudMetrics sent their Q1 invoice but it was auto-flagged for missing EU VAT registration evidence. They have a UK VAT ID on the invoice but no certificate attached. Can someone confirm whether we need reverse-charge proof or a W-8/W-9 for this vendor?
liam-tax: Quick check: is CloudMetrics registered in the UK or is that a billing address only? If they're non-UK EU supplier we need VIES lookup screenshot or their VAT cert. If US entity, we need W-8BEN-E.
olivia-ops: Invoice shows company address in London, but payment remit bank is in US. Invoice line: "VAT ID: GB999999973" — I ran the VIES lookup and it returns valid, but no document attached. I pasted the VIES link: https://ec.europa.eu/taxation_customs/vies/#/vat-validation?memberStateCode=GB&number=999999973
raj-sales: CloudMetrics was onboarded by Sales as a UK entity. I can ping their AP contact, but they usually push back on uploading docs. Do we have a minimal acceptance checklist?
emma-finance: invoice-bot flagged because our tax rules require either a VAT certificate or a signed declaration for reverse-charge. Current workflow blocks payment after 14 days if docs missing. Can we approve manually for now?
liam-tax: I can approve provisionally if we get a SCAN of their VAT reg cert or a screenshot of the VIES result captured within the last 30 days plus confirmation that they accept reverse-charge. If bank is in US, double-check their tax residency — could be a US subsidiary billing via UK branch. If US resident, we need W-8BEN-E and possibly gross-up decision.
olivia-ops: I asked AP contact (ap@cloudmetrics.com) for VAT cert and company registration number. They replied: "we're UK-registered but we invoice via CloudMetrics Inc (US)." Attached their statement: "Invoice issued by CloudMetrics Inc (EIN: 12-3456789) on behalf of CloudMetrics UK" — no VAT doc.
raj-sales: tagging @ap to escalate — they said they're doing a billing restructure. Should we hold payment or process net of withholding?
emma-finance: We need to confirm whether payment to US entity triggers US withholding — normally no for software SaaS, but depends on treaty and invoice type. Also our policy: if vendor cannot provide VAT evidence for reverse charge, we treat invoice as VAT-inclusive and cannot reclaim. For bookkeeping we need correct tax coding.
liam-tax: OK — action items: 1) Ask vendor for W-8BEN-E (if US entity) or VAT cert (if UK entity). 2) If they can't provide VAT cert, we pay but flag VAT and notify GL to record VAT expense. 3) If they're US and provide W-8, confirm no withholding required; if not provided and payment to US, consult tax counsel. I can sign off provisional allow-withhold=false if vendor provides W-8 within 5 business days.
emma-finance: Can someone draft a short email template? I'll hold payment in AP on "pending tax docs" status for now.
olivia-ops: Drafted message: "Thanks — to process this invoice we need either (a) a copy of your UK VAT registration certificate or (b) a completed W-8BEN-E if invoicing as a US entity. Please reply within 5 business days to avoid payment delay." Posting to AP now.
invoice-bot: payment_hold_created: invoice INV-2026-0813 placed on hold by emma-finance (reason: missing VAT proof).
raj-sales: Noted. I'll follow up with their finance lead and cc emma. If they push back, escalate to legal.
liam-tax: I'll standby for the doc. If we get conflicting docs (UK VAT cert + US W-8) we need to ask for explanation of invoicing entity and possibly a cross-ref to registration docs.
emma-finance: Thanks — keeping thread open. If they provide VAT cert, AP will release payment same day. If we get only W-8 we may need GL override.
